🔥 northstar-browser | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: A lightweight, secure, and standards-compliant web browser built from scratch.
✨ Key Features: • Independent browser engine (not based on Gecko, WebKit, Blink) • Targets practical HTML5, modern CSS, and JavaScript • Primary platform: Linux, with macOS and Windows support • Security features: Landlock sandbox, seccomp, no JIT • Minimalist architecture: one page per window, one process
📖 Summary: Northstar is a minimalist, independent web browser written in C, designed for Linux, macOS, and Windows. It aims for modern web standards compatibility without relying on existing browser engines like Gecko or WebKit, focusing on security and a lean architecture.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ web-shot | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Capturing entire webpages as a single image for easy sharing and archiving.
✨ Key Features: • Full-page scrolling screenshot • Saves to Downloads folder • Copies to clipboard • Handles sticky elements • Progress indicator on icon
📖 Summary: Web Shot is a Chrome extension that captures full-page scrolling screenshots of any webpage. It stitches together multiple frames into a single PNG, automatically saves it to the Downloads folder, and copies it to the clipboard for immediate use.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 AIPex | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a privacy-first, open-source, and efficient AI-powered browser automation solution that integrates seamlessly into a user's existing browsing environment.
✨ Key Features: • Zero Migration: Operates within your current browser. • Open Source: MIT licensed for transparency and extensibility. • Privacy First: Local data processing and Bring Your Own Key (BYOK). • Agent Ready: Supports MCP, skills, and browser-cli within the same runtime.
📖 Summary: AIPex is an open-source browser extension that enables AI-powered automation directly within your existing browser. It prioritizes privacy by keeping data local and offers a seamless integration without requiring new browsers or workflows.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 docker-steam-headless | Shell
🎯 Primary Use Case: To deploy a headless Steam instance in a Docker container for remote game streaming and access.
✨ Key Features: • Steam Client configured for running on Linux with Proton • Moonlight compatible server for easy remote desktop streaming • Easy installation of EmeDeck, Heroic and Lutris via Flatpak • Full video/audio noVNC web access to a Xfce4 Desktop • NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPU support
📖 Summary: This repository provides a Docker image for a headless Steam service, enabling remote game streaming. It supports NVIDIA GPU acceleration, web-based access via noVNC, and compatibility with Steam Link and Moonlight.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
